title: Employee Apply Update
prompt: A C# record-style update should not mutate the original employee. Write a function that returns a new object with update values applied over the original item.

explanation.beginner: Start by identifying what the function receives and what it must return. For Employee Apply Update, read the story as a simple input-to-output rule: A C# record-style update should not mutate the original employee. Write a function that returns a new object with update values applied over the original item. Work through one small example by hand, then write the steps in C# using plain variables before worrying about making the code shorter.
explanation.junior: Treat this as a small pure C# function: avoid mutating inputs unless the prompt explicitly asks for it, return the requested shape exactly, and let the tests drive the edge cases. The main practice area is csharp, immutability and records. Pay attention to edge cases and keep the transformation predictable as the input grows.
